en.positioning: Rescue a problematic video. Export a verified, publish-ready copy.
en.localBoundary: Full processing runs in the paired connector on this computer.

rescue.title: Start with the result you need.
rescue.description: Review observable damage, confirm a local plan, and verify a separate output copy before it is presented as publish-ready.

examples.title: Inspect the evidence behind a completed rescue.
examples.description: Each example keeps its source, actions, verification checks, and remaining limitations explicit.

caseStudy.title: A reproducible rescue record.
caseStudy.description: This public record shows the completed checks and any stated limitations. It does not claim a universal quality score.

download.title: Use the connector for full local workflows.
download.description: The public site is an entry point. Paired local software performs full processing on this computer.

developers.title: Build on inspectable local contracts.
developers.description: VideoScope keeps versioned records, observable evidence, and local-first boundaries visible to developers.

roadmap.title: Follow the work that is ready to be verified.
roadmap.description: Roadmap items describe planned work, not a delivery guarantee or a claim that an unavailable capability exists today.

community.title: Share feedback where the project can review it.
community.description: Use the project repository to discuss evidence, workflows, and reproducible local improvements.

missingCase.title: This example is not in the public manifest.
missingCase.description: No substitute result was shown for an unknown case-study address.

finalCta.title: Use the paired connector for complete local processing.
finalCta.description: The Windows setup page explains the local connector and its current availability without starting a download here.

cases.loading: Loading verified case evidence from this local site…
cases.unavailable: Verified case evidence is unavailable locally.

journey.title: Rescue
journey.description: Choose a local symptom and inspect the proposed, local plan.

journey.title: Review
journey.description: Check the evidence, limits, and a separate output before you decide.

journey.title: Publish Ready
journey.description: Export only after the declared checks complete for that copy.

funnel.boundaryDescription: Browser checks stay in this browser. Full Rescue and Publish Ready processing stays in the paired connector on this computer.
funnel.developerTitle: Develop with the same explicit boundaries.
funnel.developerDescription: Explore versioned schemas, detector contracts, and reproducible local workflows.

zh-CN.positioning: 救回存在问题的视频，导出经过验证、可供发布的新副本。
zh-CN.localBoundary: 完整处理在这台电脑已配对的本地连接器中运行。

rescue.title: 从你需要的结果开始。
rescue.description: 查看可观察到的损坏，确认本地计划，并在将独立输出副本标为可发布前完成验证。

examples.title: 查看一次已完成救援背后的证据。
examples.description: 每个示例都会明确展示其来源、执行动作、验证检查和仍存在的限制。

caseStudy.title: 一份可复现的救援记录。
caseStudy.description: 这份公开记录展示已完成的检查和已声明的限制；它不会声称存在通用质量评分。

download.title: 使用连接器运行完整本地工作流。
download.description: 公开网站是统一入口；完整处理由此电脑上已配对的本地软件完成。

developers.title: 基于可检查的本地契约进行构建。
developers.description: VideoScope 让版本化记录、可观察证据和 local-first 边界对开发者保持可见。

roadmap.title: 关注已具备验证条件的工作。
roadmap.description: 路线图条目描述计划中的工作，不保证交付，也不声称当前已具备尚不可用的能力。

community.title: 在项目可以审核的地方分享反馈。
community.description: 请通过项目仓库讨论证据、工作流和可复现的本地改进。

missingCase.title: 公开清单中没有这个示例。
missingCase.description: 对于未知的案例地址，页面不会显示替代结果。

funnel.journeyTitle: 先抢救、再复核、然后发布就绪。

journey.title: 抢救
journey.description: 选择本地症状并检查建议的本地方案。

journey.title: 复核
journey.description: 在决定前检查证据、限制和独立输出副本。

journey.title: 发布就绪
journey.description: 仅在该副本完成已声明检查后导出。

funnel.boundaryTitle: 本地、私密，并保留源文件。
funnel.boundaryDescription: 浏览器检查只在此浏览器中运行。完整的抢救和发布就绪处理只在此计算机已配对的连接器中运行。
funnel.developerTitle: 以同样明确的边界进行开发。
funnel.developerDescription: 探索版本化 schema、检测器契约和可复现的本地工作流。
